questions: When the weakness started, did you have trouble swallowing or speaking (bulbar symptoms) or any new numbness/tingling in the face, arms, or legs?
Are you having any difficulty breathing or shortness of breath, especially when lying flat?
answers: Yes. When it started I had trouble swallowing, and I also noticed weakness in both my arms and legs. I don’t have any new numbness or tingling in my face, arms, or legs.
Yes, I’m having significant difficulty breathing and shortness of breath. I also feel it can get worse when I lie flat.
